analysis_time: all consecutive pre-action public states t250..289 inclusive (40 per game), label first t+1 through t+10 inclusive; map unit for averaging and leave-one-map-out, four nonoverlap windows per game sensitivity at 250,260,270,280
x: Own minus enemy sum of positive current loads on collectors with toroidal L1 distance <=10 to nearest home. Both seats' rosters and bases are public. No carbon arrays, full map, commands or future history used in features.
y: Own minus opponent official positive own-worker bank deposits over next ten transitions; exclude all other treasury sources. Current cash difference cancelling before/after corresponds to zero incremental prediction. Fair cash-only linear calibration fit on six other maps, with intercept; joint cash plus x model, same six maps. Compare all with raw x and separate x-only LOMO.
scores: MAE, mean signed error, RMSE, correctly predicted sign among true non-ties with zero prediction as abstention; total denominator, abstained, and sign coverage provided; within-map Pearson optional with descriptive denominator. Also prediction of wallet at t+10: cash gap now versus cash gap now + predicted deposits (excludes tree and expenses).
attribution: Track exposed positive preloads by ID, who actually deposits by t+3/+5/+10, first vs later receipts and other workers; record hostile collector collision transfers separately, not wallet income. A holder can gain from collection or robbery and lose tax etc.; gross returns need not equal exposed cargo. One official replay per opponent; no causal claims.
